text.en: Reviewers speak warmly of instructors Melissa, Liz, Sarah, and Suzanne, noting their deep expertise and approachable demeanor. Clients value that trainers explain the underlying causes of behavioral issues without judgment, guiding pet parents to become effective, confident handlers.

Pet parents strongly endorse the school's force-free, positive reinforcement approach. Reviewers note that trainers avoid aversive tools, tailoring lessons to fearful or reactive rescue dogs and creating structured puppy socials where young pets build confidence in a safe setting.

Clients report significant improvements in daily manners, leash walking, and reactivity management after only a few sessions. Owners emphasize that practical tools and clear exercises taught in class give them long-term confidence to handle challenging urban situations smoothly.

q.en: Does Amanda Gagnon Dog Training use positive reinforcement methods?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize a force-free philosophy that avoids aversive training gear like prong collars.

q.en: What programs are available for young puppies?

a.en: Reviewers mention puppy kindergarten, supervised puppy socials, foundational leash training, and day school options.

q.en: Can trainers assist with fearful or reactive rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, handlers report rapid progress with reactivity and fear through targeted private sessions and specialized classes.
